title: The Milky Way's Black Hole

scenes.text: The Milky Way has a supermassive black hole
First, it is located at the galaxy's center
scenes.label: GALAXY CENTER

scenes.text: Second, it has a mass of approximately 4 million suns
scenes.label: BLACK HOLE MASS

scenes.text: Third, its gravity affects the motion of nearby stars
scenes.label: STELLAR MOTION

scenes.text: Follow to feed your curious mind daily.
